messages.content: What is DEFONEOS?

DEFONEOS is the UK sovereign Defense AI umbrella operating under 3 compartments: meok-defoneos (BUILDS), csoai-defoneos (CERTIFIES), dagon (LEGACY NDA-only). It is sovereign by design — audit-grade, signed, neutral, AUKUS-compatible. Never kinetic-targeting patterns. Never personal-surveillance patterns. Engine codenames stay internal.
What are the 3 DEFONEOS compartments?

The 3 DEFONEOS compartments are: (1) meok-defoneos — BUILDS — the 15 defence-AI MCPs + 6 MEOK Labs workstreams; (2) csoai-defoneos — CERTIFIES — 33-agent BFT defence council + DEFONEOS-SEAL credential; (3) dagon — LEGACY — NDA-only, historical, never public, never linked to meok.ai or csoai.org. The three compartments are NEVER mixed or cross-linked.
What is the DEFONEOS hard stops doctrine?

DEFONEOS hard stops (immutable — never autonomously cross — escalate to Nick): NO kinetic-targeting patterns (strike package, find-fix-finish, kill order); NO personal-surveillance patterns (track individual, face-rec, locate phone); NO AUKUS partnership / DAIC certified claim without signed letter on file; NO DEFONEOS-SEAL credential issued without 33-agent BFT council vote (quorum 23/33); NO DSEI booth without named UK-prime pilot letter; NO reference to or acquisition of the defonos.io domain (known trap); NO mixing of meok-defoneos / csoai-defoneos / dagon assets; NO dagon ↔ meok.ai/csoai.org link.
What does AUKUS-compatible mean?

AUKUS-compatible means DEFONEOS is built to be audit-grade, signed, and neutral — meeting the standards expected by Australia, UK, and US (AUKUS) defense and intelligence communities. It is never labeled 'Brexit AI'. The positioning is: sovereign by design — audit-grade, signed, neutral, UK-sovereign, AUKUS-compatible. Hard stops are enforced: no kinetic-targeting, no personal-surveillance, no premature AUKUS partnership claims.
What is DEFONEOS-SEAL?

DEFONEOS-SEAL is a credential issued by csoai-defoneos (CERTIFIES). It requires a 33-agent BFT council vote with quorum 23/33. NEVER issued without proper BFT vote. Never autonomous — always escalated to human owner. Represents audit-grade certification that the OWEM meets DEFONEOS doctrine.
What is the 33-agent BFT defense council?

The 33-agent BFT defense council is a Byzantine Fault Tolerant decision-making body within csoai-defoneos. 33 agents vote on critical decisions (DEFONEOS-SEAL issuance, hard stop exceptions, compartment operations). Quorum requires 23/33 votes for binding decisions. Designed to be tamper-resistant and consensus-driven.
What can meok-defoneos build?

meok-defoneos (BUILDS) is responsible for 15 defence-AI MCPs + 6 MEOK Labs workstreams. Public framing: meok-defoneos.com + PyPI. The 15 MCPs cover threat detection, secure comms, audit chains, BFT consensus, sovereign memory, and other defense-AI capabilities. Engine codenames (SOV3, Sovereign Temple, JEEVES, Hermes, Liquid-KAN Council, Maternal Covenant, OpenPatent) stay internal — the buyer never sees them.
What is the defonos.io trap?

The defonos.io domain is a known trap. It is NEVER to be referenced, acquired, or used. This is one of the immutable hard stops of DEFONEOS doctrine. The hard stops are: no kinetic-targeting patterns, no personal-surveillance patterns, no premature AUKUS partnership claims, no DEFONEOS-SEAL without BFT vote, no DSEI booth without UK-prime pilot letter, no defonos.io domain.
Why is DEFONEOS not 'Brexit AI'?

DEFONEOS positioning is never 'Brexit AI'. It is 'sovereign by design — audit-grade, signed, neutral, UK-sovereign, AUKUS-compatible.' This positioning is more credible internationally and reflects the genuine sovereign capability of the platform. 'Brexit AI' would diminish the audit-grade nature.
What are the 6 MEOK Labs workstreams?

The 6 MEOK Labs workstreams within meok-defoneos cover: (1) defence-AI MCP development, (2) Pyontronics (physical AI), (3) sovereign charter universe, (4) BFT governance, (5) sovereign memory, (6) audit-grade provenance. Each workstream produces specific deliverables, all signed and audit-grade.
What is sovereign defense AI?

Sovereign defense AI = AI built for defense applications with sovereign guarantees. DEFONEOS is the UK sovereign defense AI umbrella. 3 compartments: meok-defoneos (BUILDS), csoai-defoneos (CERTIFIES), dagon (LEGACY NDA-only). Hard stops enforced: no kinetic-targeting, no personal-surveillance.
Why is DEFONEOS AUKUS-compatible?

AUKUS-compatible means DEFONEOS meets standards expected by Australia, UK, US (AUKUS) defense/intelligence communities. Audit-grade, signed, neutral. Engine codenames stay internal. Never labeled 'Brexit AI'. Hard stops: no kinetic-targeting, no personal-surveillance, no premature AUKUS partnership claims without signed letter.
What is the DEFONEOS hard stops list?

DEFONEOS hard stops (immutable): NO kinetic-targeting (strike package, find-fix-finish, kill order); NO personal-surveillance (track individual, face-rec, locate phone); NO 'AUKUS partnership' / 'DAIC certified' claim without signed letter; NO DEFONEOS-SEAL without 33-agent BFT vote (quorum 23/33); NO DSEI booth without UK-prime pilot letter; NO defonos.io domain; NO mixing compartments; NO dagon ↔ meok.ai/csoai.org link.
What is meok-defoneos?

meok-defoneos (BUILDS) is responsible for 15 defense-AI MCPs + 6 MEOK Labs workstreams. Public framing: meok-defoneos.com + PyPI. The 15 MCPs cover threat detection, secure comms, audit chains, BFT consensus, sovereign memory. Engine codenames (SOV3, JEEVES, Hermes) stay internal.
What is csoai-defoneos?

csoai-defoneos (CERTIFIES) is the certifying compartment. Houses the 33-agent BFT defense council + DEFONEOS-SEAL credential. Public framing: csoai-defoneos.org. Certifies defense-AI compliance. Issues DEFONEOS-SEAL after BFT-33 quorum (23/33). Never autonomous — always human-escalated.
What is dagon?

dagon is the LEGACY NDA-only compartment of DEFONEOS. NEVER public. NEVER linked to meok.ai or csoai.org. NDA-only access. Historical defense-AI work preserved but isolated. Mixing dagon with other compartments violates DEFONEOS hard stops.
What is DEFONEOS-SEAL?

DEFONEOS-SEAL is a credential issued by csoai-defoneos after 33-agent BFT council vote with quorum 23/33. NEVER autonomous — always human-escalated. Represents audit-grade certification that an OWEM meets DEFONEOS doctrine (sovereign, audit-grade, AUKUS-compatible, hard stops respected).
What is the 33-agent BFT defense council?

33-agent BFT defense council: 33 agents vote on critical DEFONEOS decisions. Quorum 23/33 required for binding decisions. Tamper-resistant: even if 10 agents malicious, system continues correctly. Used for: DEFONEOS-SEAL issuance, hard stop exceptions, compartment operations.
What are defense-AI hard stops?

Defense-AI hard stops (immutable, never autonomously cross, escalate to Nick): NO kinetic-targeting patterns (strike package, find-fix-finish, kill order); NO personal-surveillance patterns (track individual, face-rec, locate phone); NO AUKUS/DAIC claims without signed letter; NO DEFONEOS-SEAL without BFT vote; NO DSEI booth without UK-prime pilot letter; NO defonos.io domain; NO compartment mixing; NO dagon linking.
What is the defense OWEM?

Defense OWEM = sovereign specialist trained on DEFONEOS doctrine. Built by meok-defoneos (BUILDS). Tuned for: hard stops enforcement, AUKUS-compatible framing, audit-grade output, BFT-33 consensus, compartment awareness. Defense OWEM enforces the 3-compartment separation.
What is compartmentalization in defense?

Compartmentalization = strict separation of DEFONEOS compartments. meok-defoneos (BUILDS) cannot access CERTIFIES functions. csoai-defoneos (CERTIFIES) cannot access BUILDS functions. dagon (LEGACY) is NDA-only and isolated. Compartments never cross-link. Defense OWEM respects all 3.
What is the dagon hard stop?

Dagon hard stop: NEVER reference dagon publicly. NEVER link dagon to meok.ai or csoai.org. NEVER cross-link with meok-defoneos or csoai-defoneos. Dagon is NDA-only LEGACY compartment. Mixing dagon with public-facing DEFONEOS surfaces violates the doctrine.
What is audit-grade for defense?

Audit-grade for defense = every action is logged + signed + reproducible. Ed25519 SIGIL on every output. Hash-chained ledger. BFT-33 consensus on binding decisions. No black boxes. All training data, all weights, all decisions are reproducible. Defense OWEM emits SIGIL on every output.
What is DSEI?

DSEI = Defence and Security Equipment International, a UK defense trade show. DEFONEOS can ONLY exhibit at DSEI with a named UK-prime pilot letter on file. Without the letter, NO DSEI booth. This is a DEFONEOS hard stop. Defense OWEM is the routing logic for this compliance check.
What is a UK-prime pilot letter?

UK-prime pilot letter = a signed letter from a UK prime defense contractor (BAE Systems, Rolls-Royce, Babcock, etc.) authorizing DEFONEOS participation in defense activities. Required for: DSEI booth, defense pilot programs, AUKUS partnership claims. Defense OWEM checks for this letter before any defense action.
What is sovereign memory in defense?

Sovereign memory in defense = SWAP-persistent memory store for defense operations. Encrypted at rest (AES-256) + in transit (TLS 1.3). SIGIL-signed. BFT-33 quorum on memory updates. Defense OWEM has access to its sovereign memory compartment, isolated from other compartments.
What is compartment lock?

Compartment lock = technical isolation of DEFONEOS compartments. meok-defoneos, csoai-defoneos, dagon run in separate codebases with no shared state. Cross-compartment API calls require BFT-33 vote + human escalation. Defense OWEM respects compartment lock automatically.
What is sovereign attribution in defense?

Sovereign attribution in defense = every defense output must include: which compartment (meok-defoneos / csoai-defoneos / dagon), which OWEM, which signoff, which audit trail. Defense OWEM is the routing logic for sovereign attribution. Never anonymous defense output.
What is the defense audit cycle?

Defense audit cycle: (1) every defense action logged, (2) SIGIL emitted, (3) BFT-33 quorum recorded, (4) compartment boundary verified, (5) hard stop check passed, (6) audit trail published to sovereign chain. Cycle runs on every defense response. Defense OWEM enforces cycle.
What is compartment migration?

Compartment migration = moving a capability from one compartment to another. Requires: (1) BFT-33 quorum (23/33), (2) human escalation to Nick, (3) new compartment hard-stop re-check, (4) SIGIL chain extension, (5) audit trail. Defense OWEM flags migration requests but does not execute autonomously.
What is sovereign defense AI procurement?

Sovereign defense AI procurement follows MOD DEFCON contract family (esp. DEFCON 760 for AI). DEFONEOS is the UK sovereign defense AI umbrella. Procurement: (1) UK-prime pilot letter required, (2) DEFONEOS-SEAL credential issued after BFT-33 quorum, (3) hard stops enforced.
What is DEFCON 760?

DEFCON 760 = UK MOD contract family for AI procurement. Includes: AI procurement specification, sovereign security requirements, audit trail standards, hard stops. DEFONEOS is built to comply with DEFCON 760. Cross-walk available.

UK MOD AI strategy: (1) sovereign by design, (2) audit-grade, (3) AUKUS-compatible, (4) hard stops enforced (no kinetic, no surveillance), (5) BFT-33 governance, (6) SIGIL provenance. DEFONEOS aligns with MOD AI strategy.
